name: Conformance: LLM cache key recipe 2 (RFC 0260)
description: Fixture for `v2-replay-llm-cache-key.test.ts` (RFC 0260; the rules are the `replay.llmCacheKeyRecipe` facet description and the effect-ledger `cacheKey` description). One node, `conformance.callai.cache-key` (conformance-RESERVED). It makes exactly one `ctx.callAI` call through the host's conformance mock provider, whose provider id is `conformance-mock` and model id `conformance-mock-1`. The call sends one message `{role: "user", content: inputs.request.prompt}`, no tools, no toolChoice, no responseSchema, and exactly the parameters in `inputs.request.params` (keys from recipe 2's named set: `temperature`, `maxTokens`, `stop`, `seed`, `topP`, `topK`, `frequencyPenalty`, `presencePenalty`), nothing more. The mock replies `ok`. The host records the call on `GET /runs/{runId}/effects` under this node's id, carrying `cacheKey`. The node completes with `outputs.text`, the reply. A host that does not advertise `replay.llmCacheKeyRecipe` MUST NOT advertise this fixture.
